## Purpose

Describe the general problem and the bounded change.

## Validation

- [ ] New or changed behavior has automated tests.
- [ ] Full regression and release-identity checks pass.
- [ ] No secrets, client evidence, target identifiers, recovered proof values, browser profiles, or local databases are included.
- [ ] Security verdict changes include independent secure and vulnerable fixtures.
- [ ] Catalog or recipe changes include benchmark evidence and false-positive controls.
- [ ] Documentation and versioned schemas are updated when behavior or persisted contracts change.

## Safety and compatibility

Describe scope-boundary, migration, evidence, reproducibility, and backward-compatibility effects.
